title: Without JavaScript the cart, checkout and payment-return pages bake a loading line that never ends («جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…» beside «يحتاج JavaScript»)
evidence: PaymentReturn renders headline 'جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…' while target is undefined, which is the state the static export is rendered in; CartView.tsx:170 «جارٍ تحميل السلة…» and CheckoutForm.tsx:452 «جارٍ تحميل الطلب…» likewise. Rendered out/ with javaScriptEnabled:false at 360: /checkout/return shows «التحقق من الدفع يحتاج JavaScript. جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…», /cart «السلة والطلب يحتاجان JavaScript. جارٍ تحميل السلة…», /checkout «… جارٍ تحميل الطلب…» (shots/p1-nojs-return-none-360.png). R10A-5 removed exactly this from /orders and tests/e2e/no-js.spec.ts:105-114 asserts it only for /orders and /notify/*.
impact: A buyer returning from the payment page with script blocked reads that the payment is being checked, forever, next to a note saying it cannot be; the two sentences contradict each other on a money page. No money effect: verify never runs, nothing is cleared.
proposed_fix: Render nothing in the status line while the client state is undefined (as OrderPage does since R10A-5): in PaymentReturn return an empty role=status line until target is read, and in CartView/CheckoutForm render the loading note only after mount (or leave the static shell empty); extend no-js.spec.ts's loop to /cart, /checkout and /checkout/return.
prior_overlap: R10A-5 fixed the same defect on /orders only

title: The hold view pays the pending order without showing what it holds or noticing it differs from what the buyer last confirmed: an edited retry after a lost reply, or a cart changed after the order, is paid as the old order
evidence: Two paths reach the same blind hold view. (1) ACTIVE_HOLD: `const mine = pendingOrderOf({ orderNumber: handedNumber, accessToken: fields.accessToken }) ?? readPendingOrder(); if (mine) { writePendingOrder(mine); setStart(null); ... setPending(mine)` takes the session's held order, which the SQL hands back whenever the email matches (20261002110000_checkout_payment.sql:486-497) whatever else differs; a changed field mints a new idempotency key (CheckoutForm.tsx:348-354), so the retry is never the duplicate of the first. (2) CheckoutForm.tsx:456 `if (pending !== null) return <HoldView .../>` before the cart is even looked at, so a cart edited after the order still opens the old order. HoldView.tsx:206-276 shows only the number, the total, the hold time and «ادفع الآن»; no lines, address or phone are shown there, on the order page or in the receipt. Reproduced on today's out/ with mocked functions: (1) pass4-hold.mjs scenario e: first create's reply lost, address changed from «حي النرجس، شارع أنس بن مالك، مبنى 12» to «حي الياسمين، شارع القيروان، مبنى 7، الدور الثاني», the second create (new key) answered ACTIVE_HOLD with the order, hold view «رقم الطلب: K7M2P9QX … ادفع الآن» with no notice (shots/p4-active-hold-handed-back-360.png); (2) pass7-flows.mjs A: order for one e-book (35.00), the cart then raised to 3 (105.00), «المتابعة لإتمام الطلب» opens «رقم الطلب: K7M2P9QX الإجمالي: 35.00 ر.س … ادفع الآن» (shots/p7-cart-edited-after-order-360.png). After payment PaymentReturn.tsx:61 `writeCart(EMPTY_CART)` empties the whole cart, including the lines that were never in the paid order.
impact: The buyer pays the earlier order and believes it is the one they just confirmed: goods go to an uncorrected address or phone, items added after the order are neither bought nor left in the cart (the return page empties it), and a coupon added on the retry is not applied (they pay the higher total). Precondition for (1): create committed but its reply was lost and the buyer edited a field before pressing again; for (2): the buyer went back to the store or the cart while the order waited for payment. The difference surfaces only at delivery or in the receipt's lines.
proposed_fix: Make the hold view say what it is paying for and when it is not the current request: show the order's lines (already in the create/pay reply's `order.lines` and in ACTIVE_HOLD's `fields.order`) above the total, and when they or the total differ from the current cart's quote, or when the order was handed back by ACTIVE_HOLD, show «هذا طلبك السابق بتفاصيله الأولى؛ إن عدّلت شيئًا فألغِ الطلب ثم أكّد من جديد.» beside «إلغاء الطلب». On the return page, clear only when the cart still equals what was ordered, or leave the cart alone and say the order is paid. Put the lines and the comparison in HoldView.tsx, which is already a lazy chunk, and pass only a small flag (handed back by ACTIVE_HOLD) and the current quote total from CheckoutForm, because the checkout page's first script is at 148.9 of its 150 KiB budget (I50 (2)).
prior_overlap: I48 (3) records ACTIVE_HOLD's wording for a hold the tab cannot reach (FIX-public-4); the substitution of a different order for the edited request or the changed cart is not recorded

title: Checkout and hold view disable the pressed button while their request runs, so every refusal or failure drops keyboard focus to the top of the document
evidence: `disabled={!turnstileAvailable || submitting || waiting || stale || noCities || policiesStale}` on «تأكيد الطلب», and HoldView.tsx:224/262/267 `disabled={submitting}` on «أعد المحاولة» and «إلغاء الطلب». A focused button that becomes disabled loses focus (focus fixup). Measured on today's out/ with mocked replies: after a create answered TURNSTILE, RATE_LIMITED, FAILED, CHECKOUT_DISABLED, INVALID_CONTACT, ADDRESS_REQUIRED, PHONE_REQUIRED, ACTIVE_HOLD, a 502 HTML gateway or a lost connection, document.activeElement is BODY (pass4.out.txt, every `refusal-*` row: "focus":"BODY.#"); in the hold view after «أعد المحاولة» answered by a lost connection and «إلغاء الطلب» answered 409 PAYMENT_ACTIVE, focus is BODY (pass5.out.txt hold-failure-focus). The same pattern was fixed with aria-disabled on «تحديث» (R4B-02), the order page and the notification pages.
impact: A keyboard or screen-reader buyer whose order is refused hears the alert but is sent back to the start of the page (skip link, header, menu) and must tab through the whole page to reach the fields or the button again; on the hold view the same happens after a failed retry or cancel. It is the checkout, the one journey that must work for everyone.
proposed_fix: Use the pattern the other money pages already use: keep the buttons enabled and set `aria-disabled={submitting || waiting || undefined}` while busy (submit() already returns early on `submitting`; HoldView's cancelOrder already guards, loadPayment needs the same `if (submitting) return` guard), keeping `disabled` only for the static reasons (no site key, stale summary, no cities, policies being updated).
prior_overlap: R4B-02 fixed the same defect on the return page's «تحديث»; R10A applied it to OrderPage and NotifyAction

title: After its 30-second schedule the return page still says «جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…» for an order whose payment never came
evidence: `let headline: ReactNode = 'جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…'` is kept for state 'pending' whether or not anything is still being asked; `done` only adds «تحديث». Rendered with verify answering pending six times (0, 2.1, 4.2, 8.2, 15.2, 30.1 s): after 32 s the page reads «جارٍ التحقق من الدفع… متابعة الدفع ← وضع تجريبي: لا يُخصم أي مبلغ حقيقي تحديث» (pass5.out.txt return-pending-tab, shots/p5-return-pending-tab-360.png). The invoice's back_url is this same page (payments.ts:191-193), so a buyer who leaves the invoice without paying, or whose card was declined and pressed back, lands here.
impact: A buyer who did not pay is told, with no end, that their payment is being checked; some will leave believing the order is going through and the hold lapses silently 20 minutes later. The order page says «بانتظار الدفع.» for the same state, so the two pages disagree.
proposed_fix: Once the schedule has run out (or a throttle stopped it) with the state still pending, change the line to a settled sentence such as «لم يتأكد الدفع بعد.» (or the order page's «بانتظار الدفع.»), keep «متابعة الدفع» and «تحديث», and put the test-mode note after both actions instead of between them.
prior_overlap: round-04b listed the post-schedule state as untested; no ruling on its wording

title: The coupon row's «تطبيق» button sits 18px below the code field on the cart and the checkout from 768px
evidence: `.coupon { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; ... }` holds the label (class `.field`, which carries `margin-block-end: 18px`, line 396) and the button; flex-end aligns the label's margin box, so the input's bottom edge ends 18px above the button's. Measured on today's out/ (probe-tracking.mjs): /cart and /checkout at 768, 1024 and 1440 all give input bottom = button bottom − 18 (e.g. 1024 /checkout input 433–489, button 451–507); shots/p2-cart-full-city-1440.png and shots/p3-form-1440.png show the step. `.coupon input { inline-size: 12rem }` (line 387) is also dead: `.field input { inline-size: 100% }` (line 403) comes later with the same specificity.
impact: On the money pages, which the owner wants to look official, the one inline field-and-button pair is visibly out of line (DESIGN-AUDIT 44, aligned controls); no functional effect.
proposed_fix: Give the coupon label no bottom margin inside the row: `.coupon .field { margin-block-end: 0; }` (and drop or fix the dead `.coupon input` width).
prior_overlap: none found in AUDIT-1, AUDIT-2 or the tasmeem audit

title: A tracking number with hyphens breaks at a hyphen on a phone and reads «رقم التتبع: -SMSA-290012345678» with «RUH» alone on the next line
evidence:
`

رقم التتبع: {item.tracking}

` with `.wrap { overflow-wrap: anywhere }`: the isolated LTR run is broken after a hyphen like any text. At 360 the code SMSA-290012345678-RUH lays out as two fragments (x 70–249 on line 1, x 288–323 on line 2): the trailing hyphen of fragment one lands beside the Arabic label and the suffix starts the next RTL line at the far edge (shots/z-tracking-360.png).
impact: The buyer reads or types a wrong tracking number into the carrier's site (a leading hyphen, the suffix missed or put first). Tracking values are the owner's free text (≤120 characters), so hyphens and spaces are likely.
proposed_fix: Keep the code whole and isolated: `<bdi dir="ltr" className={styles.code}>` with `.code { display: inline-block; max-inline-size: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` so it moves to its own line as a unit and only breaks inside when wider than the line; the same for the order number spans if they ever grow.

title: With storage blocked, leaving the checkout and coming back forgets the pending order and mints a new checkout session, so the same cart is ordered again and its stock held twice
evidence: `checkoutSession()` reads sessionStorage and otherwise mints `crypto.randomUUID()`; with storage denied the write is dropped, so every mount of CheckoutForm (sessionRef is per mount, CheckoutForm.tsx:160/355) gets a new session, and `readPendingOrder()` (cart.ts:501) returns null, so the form, not the hold view, comes back. The cart itself survives client navigations in the module's memoryCart (cart.ts:233), so nothing stops a second order. Reproduced on today's out/ with both storages throwing (pass8-denied.mjs): add on /store/demo-room-wallpapers, cart, checkout, create → «رقم الطلب: K7M2P9QX»; browser Back to the cart, «المتابعة لإتمام الطلب» → the empty form again; create → «رقم الطلب: R4T6W8YZ»; the two create bodies carry different checkoutSession values (01e49f42… and a68aef8d…), so ACTIVE_HOLD never fires.
impact: A buyer whose browser blocks site storage (all cookies blocked, some privacy modes) who steps back to the cart after confirming creates a second pending order for the same items: scarce stock is held twice for 20 minutes, the first order's invoice link is gone from the page, and the per-session hold limit of contract section 13 does not apply to them.
proposed_fix: Give the session id and the pending order the same in-memory fallback the cart already has: module-level `memorySession` and `memoryPending` in cart.ts used when sessionStorage is denied, so they survive client navigations within the tab like the memory cart does; optionally show the cart's «المتصفح يمنع الحفظ» note on the checkout too.
prior_overlap: round-10a listed 'sessionStorage that throws' as untested for the order page only

title: The cart still swallows a failed or empty city list: an empty select and «اختر مدينة التوصيل.» with nothing to choose and no retry
evidence: `fetchCities().then(setCities).catch(() => setCities([]))`: a failure and an empty list look the same, and the cart renders no message and no retry for either. Rendered on today's out/ with the shipping_rates read failing (pass2-cart.mjs cart-cities-fail): the select's options are only «اختر المدينة», the one alert is the quote's «اختر مدينة التوصيل.» placed under the coupon's «تطبيق» button, no «أعد المحاولة», and «المتابعة لإتمام الطلب» is still offered (shots/p2-cart-cities-fail-360.png). The checkout got the fix for AUDIT-2 STORE-checkout-5 (CheckoutForm.tsx:690-710: «تعذّر تحميل قائمة المدن.» with a retry, «لا نوصل إلى أي مدينة حاليًا.» for an empty list); the cart did not.
impact: The buyer of a book or a mug is told to choose a delivery city from a list that has none, with no explanation, on the page where they decide whether to go on; some will conclude delivery is not offered and leave. With no cities configured at all they are sent on to a checkout whose button is disabled.
proposed_fix: Reuse the checkout's handling in the cart: keep a `citiesState` ('loading' | 'failed' | 'loaded'), show «تعذّر تحميل قائمة المدن.» with «أعد المحاولة» on failure and «لا نوصل إلى أي مدينة حاليًا.» (and no checkout link) when the list loaded empty for a physical cart; put the city error next to the select rather than under the coupon.

title: The hold's end is a bare Riyadh clock time («محجوز حتى 05:52»): a buyer in another time zone misreads how long the order is held
evidence: `formatRiyadhTime` formats with `timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh'` and the views print it with no zone: HoldView.tsx:241 «محجوز حتى {formatRiyadhTime(holdEnds)}» and CheckoutForm.tsx:779 «لديك طلب محجوز من هذه الجلسة حتى …». Rendered: «محجوز حتى 05:52» (pass4 hold-ready). P08-CONTRACT.md:480 asks for 'a plain clock time in Riyadh'. Digital-only carts need no Saudi address or phone, so buyers abroad can order.
impact: A reader in the UAE (UTC+4) sees a hold time already past on their own clock and may abandon or cancel a live order; one in Egypt, Morocco or Europe thinks they have one to three hours more than the 20 minutes and comes back to an expired hold. Nothing is lost but the order.
proposed_fix: Say which clock it is («محجوز حتى 05:52 بتوقيت السعودية»), or format the same instant in the device's own time zone (drop `timeZone` for this display only; the timer already uses the instant). Amend the contract sentence with it.
prior_overlap: none; the contract chose Riyadh time without a zone label

title: The working tree's checkout_price refuses a digital line above one copy, but the product page and the cart still offer 1 to 20 and explain the refusal with «الكمية يجب أن تكون بين 1 و20.» for a quantity of 2
evidence: Uncommitted 20261007110000_fable_audit_operations.sql:1079-1084: `if v_row.fulfillment = 'digital' and v_qty <> 1 then ... 'INVALID_QUANTITY'`. The UI is unchanged: AddToCart.tsx:168-177 offers `type="number" min={1} max={MAX_QUANTITY}` for every variant (VariantAction gets no fulfillment), addLine (cart.ts:96-119) merges a second add into quantity 2, CartView.tsx:266-274 keeps «+» enabled to 20, and quote.ts:364-365 maps INVALID_QUANTITY to «الكمية يجب أن تكون بين 1 و20.». Rendered with the quote mocked to the new rule (pass10-digital-qty.mjs): two presses of «أضف إلى السلة» on the e-book give «أُضيف إلى السلة. في السلة الآن 2.»; the cart then shows «منتج في السلة», «…», «الكمية يجب أن تكون بين 1 و20.» beside a quantity of 2, totals 0.00 ر.س and «أزل غير المتاح أو عدّل الكمية لإتمام الطلب.» (shots/p10-cart-digital-qty2-360.png). With the committed SQL instead, the same cart is charged for two copies and grants one download.
impact: The e-book is the flagship product. A buyer who presses «أضف إلى السلة» twice, or wants two copies, is blocked by a sentence that contradicts what they see (2 is between 1 and 20), with the line unnamed and the totals at zero; «إزالة غير المتاح» deletes the e-book outright. Some will give up. Until the migration lands, the opposite failure: they pay for copies they never receive.
proposed_fix: Ship the UI half with the migration: pass `digital` (variant.fulfillment === 'digital') to VariantAction → AddToCart and render no quantity field for it (add 1; a second add says it is already in the cart); cap a digital line at 1 in addLine/setQuantity via the quote's fulfillment and hide the stepper for `quoteLine.fulfillment === 'digital'`; have the SQL error carry `maximum: 1` (parseError already reads `minimum`; add `maximum`) and say «النسخة الرقمية تُشترى نسخةً واحدة.» for it.
proof_recipe: After `supabase migration up` with 20261007110000: select (public.checkout_quote(repeat('a',64), '[{"variantId":"<e-book variant id>","quantity":2}]'::jsonb, null, null)) -> 'errors' → expect [{"code":"INVALID_QUANTITY","line":1,"variantId":…}]; then on the dev build add the e-book twice on /store/demo-khous and open /cart: wrong result is «الكمية يجب أن تكون بين 1 و20.» next to the quantity 2.
prior_overlap: FABLE-AUDIT round M1b section 6 (server half, in progress); no UI change in the working tree
